preston_pressure_kernel — DRIVE polish op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar × scalar → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.preston_pressure_kernel(force: 'float', radius: 'float', res: 'float', kind: 'str' = 'flat', estar=None, normalize: 'bool' = False) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import polish; polish.preston_pressure_kernel(force: 'float', radius: 'float', res: 'float', kind: 'str' = 'flat', estar=None, normalize: 'bool' = False) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("preston_pressure_kernel"))

Usage

Window of the pressure [Pa] under the tool, sampled at pixel centers (odd × odd; the center pixel is the tool center). Flat: uniform F/(πa²) inside the circle; Hertz: p0 √(1 − r²/a²) (radius = sphere radius R, requires estar). With normalize=True it is scaled so that Σ p · res² = F (removes the error of the pixel-counted circle area, so that FFT convolution preserves volume). Raises ValueError: force, radius or pixel not positive, unknown kind, Hertz without estar, contact radius smaller than 1 pixel.
